shots.action: The courier points toward a winding town path as neighbors gather.
shots.narration: Tonight, our little town takes the scenic route.
shots.comic_caption: A small invitation sets off a big walk.
shots.gag: Scale Contrast: A single invitation scroll unfurls into a giant parade banner over the tiny town.
shots.scene_setting: Miniature town square at dusk, paper lanterns and one oversized letter prop.
shots.audio_cue: Soft evening ambience and a distant clock chime.

shots.camera: slow pan across the harbor path
shots.action: The courier follows the newly installed lamps along the water.
shots.narration: New lamps brighten the harbor path.
shots.comic_caption: The harbor path glows for evening walkers.
shots.gag: Absurd Literalization: The new lamps literally light a glowing runway down the harbor path.
shots.scene_setting: Harbor path with rows of tiny glowing lamp posts along the water.
shots.audio_cue: Warm electric hum and gentle water lapping.

shots.action: The pigeon flutters from one lamp post to the next.
shots.narration: Pip checks each light along the way.
shots.gag: Relatable Exaggeration: Pip checks every lamp like a fussy landlord inspecting twenty bulbs.
shots.scene_setting: Harbor path close-up, a lamp post and a fluttering pigeon.
shots.audio_cue: Rapid wing flutters and a proud pigeon coo.

shots.camera: overhead view of a printed map
shots.action: They trace an accessible loop beside the river.
shots.narration: A map offers six routes by the river.
shots.comic_caption: A clear map makes room for everyone.
shots.gag: Scale Contrast: The map unfolds until it covers the whole river like a picnic blanket.
shots.scene_setting: Overhead toy river with a giant printed map spread over it.
shots.audio_cue: Paper crinkle and a delighted town murmur.

shots.camera: gentle push-in on the blue canopy
shots.action: The mayor welcomes walkers beneath the market canopy.
shots.narration: The market canopy becomes their meeting place.
shots.comic_caption: Under blue cloth, the group gathers.
shots.gag: Relatable Exaggeration: The mayor welcomes walkers like a tiny cruise director with a megaphone.
shots.scene_setting: Market square under a blue canopy, tiny flags strung up.

shots.action: The courier ties bright seed packets to temporary route markers.
shots.narration: Native flower seeds mark the garden stop.
shots.comic_caption: A few seeds add color to the route.
shots.gag: Absurd Literalization: The seed packets sprout miniature flowers on the spot as they are tied on.
shots.scene_setting: Garden fence with bright seed packets tied to route markers.
shots.audio_cue: Soft pops of tiny flowers blooming.

shots.action: The pigeon hops past the garden gate beside the walkers.
shots.narration: Pip leads the last turn past the garden.
shots.gag: Scale Contrast: Pip hops beside the walkers, each hop clearing the entire garden fence.
shots.scene_setting: Garden gate and fence line in the miniature town.
shots.audio_cue: Playful hop sounds and a light breeze.

shots.action: The group waves outside the reopened clock workshop.
shots.narration: They finish together, right on town time.
shots.comic_caption: The clock shop marks the end of a shared stroll.
shots.gag: Absurd Literalization: The group waves goodnight as the clock hands spin back to greet them.
shots.scene_setting: Reopened clock workshop facade with a round clock face.
shots.audio_cue: Clockwork ticks and a warm goodnight chorus.
